description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the performance gain (+%) on tasks through predictive rollout search, comparing two supervision methods across three different language models. The horizontal category axis displays the models in the following order: GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and Qwen2-72B-VL. The vertical value axis is labeled "Performance Gain (+%)" and utilizes a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with numeric tick labels spaced at regular intervals of 5. Dashed horizontal grid lines extend from each tick mark across the background. At each model category on the horizontal axis, two bars are grouped side-by-side. As indicated by the legend positioned at the top of the chart, the left bar in each group represents "Strong Supervision" and is visually emphasized with a blue color containing white diagonal hatching, while the right bar represents "Weak Supervision" and is filled with a solid light blue color. The chart does not follow a strict ascending or descending sort order across the horizontal axis, though the Strong Supervision bars are consistently taller than the Weak Supervision bars within every group. For the GPT-4o category, the Strong Supervision bar is the tallest in the chart at approximately 24.5%, while the corresponding Weak Supervision bar is about 5.5%. In the Claude-3.5-Sonnet category, the Strong Supervision bar measures approximately 9.5%, paired with the chart's shortest overall bar for Weak Supervision at roughly 3.5%. Finally, in the Qwen2-72B-VL category, the Strong Supervision bar reaches 15%, alongside a Weak Supervision bar measuring approximately 5.5%.
